package.name: base101_slam
package.description: SLAM and odometry-fusion stack for base101: robot_localization EKF + slam_toolbox (mapping by default, localization via service switch) and the version-controlled maps directory. Deliberately independent of base101_nav: either stack launches, runs and dies on its own; the only coupling is the /map topic and the map->odom TF that slam_toolbox publishes for whoever is listening.
